systems.country_label: electronic medical record (EMR) to be linked to the HIE

BWA.note: Financing text names an EMR only as a system to be linked; no tiers, sites or digitising stated.

facts.fact: The World Bank approved on 26 January 2026 US$13.1 million of IBRD financing under Botswana's HEPRR project to enhance the health information exchange (HIE) by linking digital systems including the EMR and eIDSR, and by developing and linking registries.
